errors.text: The alloy is not identified as equiatomic FeNiCrMn; much of the hypothesis and supporting evidence instead concerns quinary CoCrFeMnNi.
The proposed experimental strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^-1 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1.
Strain-rate insensitivity is restricted to below 100 K, whereas the target result found negligible yield-strength sensitivity across the simulated temperatures and strain-rate window.
The proposed lattice-friction saturation mechanism omits vacancy/disordered-site nucleation of Shockley partials and associated intrinsic and extrinsic stacking faults.
The cited evidence does not directly establish cryogenic strain-rate-insensitive yielding in bulk single-crystal FeNiCrMn.
